known_limitations: Offline expensive reference, not production implementation.
Uses deterministic pseudo-basemap for self-contained validation, not Leaflet tiles.
If visual drift from 2.41d is observed, adjust transport sampling/overlap/masking only; transfer LUT remains locked.

qa_questions.coherent_directional_pressure: intended by local orthogonal slice transport
qa_questions.dense_mids_preserved: intended by locked LUT sampling per local cross-section

rendering_method: Offline Python/PIL/numpy supersampled render. Samples locked 2.41d transfer LUT, resamples Phase 2.36f centerline and boundaries, computes local tangent/normal, and transports the transfer via dense local orthogonal cross-section splats with overlap. Exact projected polygon mask applied.
scope: validation-only orthogonal transport renderer using locked transfer
